name: rn-a11y-host
description: Prebuilt headless React Native host (Fantom: Fabric + Hermes + Yoga) used by react-native-a11y-tree: macOS (universal) and Linux x64.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const fail=f=>{console.error('rn-a11y-host: '+f+' is missing: run bun scripts/release-host.ts --pack in the repo root first');process.exit(1)};for(const f of ['index.js','index.d.ts','host-version.json'])if(!fs.existsSync(f))fail(f);const bins=Object.keys(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('host-version.json','utf8')).binaries||{});if(bins.length===0)fail('a binary (host-version.json binaries)');for(const f of bins)if(!fs.existsSync(f))fail(f)"
